jobs.title: Director, Internal Audit Analytics & Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director, Internal Audit Analytics & Artificial Intelligence leads the Audit Analytics and AI function within Internal Audit, driving the adoption of data analytics, automation and emerging technologies to enhance audit quality, efficiency, and insight generation.

Reporting to the Audit and Analytics SVP, the Director partners closely with audit leaders and business stakeholders, both from Brookfield and Portfolio Companies, to integrate analytics and AI across the audit lifecycle, identify opportunities for innovation, and develop scalable solutions that strengthen the Internal Audit function. This role combines technical expertise with strong leadership, requiring excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

Key Responsibilities

Leadership & Strategy

Lead the continued development and execution of the Internal Audit Analytics & AI strategy and roadmap.
Identify opportunities to expand analytics, automation, and AI across audit engagements.
Lead and develop a high-performing analytics team while fostering collaboration and innovation.
Establish priorities and best practices for analytics and AI within Internal Audit.

Audit Analytics & AI

Lead the integration of analytics throughout the audit lifecycle.
Oversee scalable analytics to identify risks, anomalies, and control weaknesses.
Drive the evaluation and implementation of AI, generative AI, process mining, and intelligent automation.
Promote responsible AI practices aligned with governance expectations.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Partner with audit leadership, Technology, Finance, Risk, and business stakeholders.
Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior management.
Translate technical concepts into clear business insights.

Technology Leadership

Provide technical direction for Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, Python and LLM tools (Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude), including prompt engineering, automation and agents.
Support scalable data architecture and visualization capabilities.

People Leadership

Mentor and develop analytics professionals.
Promote knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Support capability development.

Qualifications & Experience

Education

Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting or a related field.

Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in Audit Analytics and AI, Digital and AI Transformation.
Experience leading analytics initiatives and managing teams.
Experience presenting insights to senior management.

Leadership Competencies

Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to influence without direct authority.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Passion for innovation and emerging technologies.

Backfill

jobs.title: Director, Platform Systems
jobs.description:
Opentext - The Information Company

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.

YOUR IMPACT

OpenText is looking for an experienced and collaborative technology leader to join our Corporate IT organization as Director, Platform Systems
. In this global leadership role, you will be responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operational excellence of critical enterprise capabilities across Integration Systems, Security and Identity Access Management, and Fulfillment Systems. You will lead distributed teams, partner with business and technology stakeholders, and help modernize the systems and practices that enable secure, scalable, and efficient business operations.

What The Role Offers

Leading and influencing in a global, matrixed environment with teams and stakeholders across multiple regions.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, licensing decisions, and platform investments with a focus on business value, simplification, and cost effectiveness.
Work with technologies that may include Cloud Integration Hub/ICDM, SAP PI/PO, SAP Integration Suite/BTP, Boomi, MuleSoft, Google Cloud Platform, IAM platforms, licensing and fulfillment systems, APIs, automation, and observability tools.
Building trusted relationships with business partners, technology leaders, architects, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and consultants.
Communicating clearly with executive, business, technical, and operational audiences.
Bringing structure, transparency, and prioritization to complex portfolios of work.
Driving Agile ways of working, delivery predictability, team accountability, and continuous improvement.
Applying AI and automation thoughtfully to improve speed, quality, operational insight, documentation, testing, and productivity.
Balancing strategic planning with hands-on leadership in a fast-paced, business-critical environment.
Simplifying technology landscapes, reducing risk, improving resilience, and aligning work to measurable outcomes.
Promoting strong development, integration, security, identity, fulfillment, documentation, and operational practices.
Staying current on emerging trends in integration platforms, IAM, application security, fulfillment, cloud, APIs, AI, and automation.

What You Need To Succeed

10+ years of progressive experience leading application, development, enterprise systems, integration, security, identity, fulfillment, or platform teams.
Demonstrated experience leading global teams, managing multiple workstreams, and delivering business-critical technology services.
Strong technical leadership experience across enterprise integration platforms, API management, cloud integration, SAP integration technologies, IAM tools, fulfillment or licensing systems, and modern application delivery practices.
Agile training or certification is required; hands-on experience leading Agile teams, Scrum practices, backlog management, delivery metrics, and Agile maturity improvement is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of AI capabilities and practical use cases in Integration, Security, Identity Management, and Fulfillment Systems, including automation, developer productivity, observability, testing, application security, and operational efficiency.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate technical complexity into clear business language.
Strong people leadership skills, including coaching, performance management, talent development, succession planning, and building engaged teams.
Strong analytical, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, matrixed environment while maintaining delivery discipline, operational rigor, and stakeholder confidence.
Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, enterprise transformation, or major technology modernization initiatives is an asset.
High-tech software or enterprise software industry experience is an asset.
A relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree, college diploma, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

One Last Thing

OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned.

Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.

OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:
At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:
Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:
As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

jobs.title: Director of Financial Reporting
jobs.description:
SETUP
: Mostly remote, only required 1-2 times/month in office. Located in North York, ON

CONTRACT
: 18 months

About the Opportunity

Financial Reporting & Consolidations:
Lead the preparation and review of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements and management reporting.
Oversee the consolidation of multiple legal entities/business units, including intercompany balances, eliminations, foreign currency translation, and consolidation adjustments.
Ensure financial reporting is accurate, complete, appropriately supported, and delivered within established reporting timelines.
Maintain and enhance consolidation processes, reporting packages, and financial controls.
Partner with business units and finance teams to resolve consolidation and reporting issues.

US GAAP & IFRS:
Serve as a key technical accounting resource for matters involving US GAAP and IFRS.
Research and assess complex accounting issues and provide recommendations regarding appropriate accounting treatment.
Monitor new and emerging accounting standards and assess their impact on the organization.
Lead the implementation of new accounting standards and changes to existing reporting requirements.
Prepare and review technical accounting memos, position papers, and supporting documentation.
Support accounting matters involving areas such as revenue recognition, leases, business combinations, foreign currency, impairment, and other complex transactions, as applicable.

Controls, Audit & Compliance:
Maintain a strong financial control environment across the reporting and consolidation processes.
Coordinate with internal and external auditors and support quarterly and annual audit requirements.
Ensure appropriate documentation and supporting schedules are maintained for significant accounting judgments, estimates, and transactions.
Identify reporting and control risks and implement process improvements to strengthen financial governance.
Leadership & Business Partnership:
Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4–5 finance and accounting professionals, establishing clear responsibilities and development priorities.
Provide technical guidance and oversight to the team while promoting accountability and high-quality execution.
Partner closely with FP&A, Corporate Accounting, Tax, Treasury, and other finance functions to ensure consistency and accuracy across financial reporting.
Work with senior leadership to communicate financial reporting matters, accounting implications, and significant issues.
Support acquisitions, integrations, restructuring activities, and other strategic initiatives from an accounting and reporting perspective.

Process Improvement:
Drive improvements to the financial close, consolidation, and reporting processes with a focus on accuracy, efficiency, standardization, and scalability.
Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reconciliation activities.
Strengthen reporting processes, systems, and controls as the organization grows and reporting requirements evolve.

About You

CPA designation.
10+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including significant experience in a leadership capacity.
Strong technical knowledge and practical application of US GAAP and/or IFRS.
Significant experience with multi-entity consolidations, including intercompany eliminations and foreign currency considerations.
Experience leading and developing accounting or financial reporting teams.

jobs.title: Director, Development Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Cortel Group | Vaughan, Ontario

Employment Type:
Full-Time, Permanent
Experience:
8–12+ Years
Reports To:
Company Leadership & Partners
About Cortel Group

Cortel Group is an established real estate development company specializing in high-rise residential condominiums, commercial developments, and purpose-built rental communities throughout the Greater Toronto Area.

We are seeking an experienced, analytical, and proactive Director, Development Finance & Accounting
to lead the financial management of our development portfolio, oversee accounting operations, and provide strategic financial guidance directly to company leadership and partners.

This is a hands-on leadership position combining real estate development finance, project feasibility analysis, financial reporting, and team management. The successful candidate will play an important role in evaluating development opportunities, monitoring project performance, identifying financial risks, and improving the effectiveness of the Finance Department.

Key Responsibilities

Development Finance & Feasibility Analysis

Lead financial feasibility assessments for prospective and existing real estate development projects.
Develop, maintain, and evaluate detailed development pro formas, financial models, cash flow projections, and investment return analyses.
Conduct sensitivity and scenario analyses to assess the impact of changes in construction costs, development charges, financing rates, sales prices, rental rates, absorption, and project timelines.
Evaluate project profitability, financial viability, capital requirements, and investment risks.
Provide financial analysis, recommendations, and strategic insights directly to company leadership and partners to support acquisition, development, financing, and investment decisions.
Review and challenge project assumptions, identifying potential risks and opportunities to improve financial outcomes.

Project Financial Management & Oversight

Oversee financial management and reporting across multiple real estate development projects.
Manage development budgets, cost tracking, cash flow forecasts, financial commitments, and variance analyses.
Monitor project financial performance throughout the development lifecycle, from acquisition and construction through occupancy, stabilization, and final closing.
Oversee construction financing, lender reporting, and construction draw requirements.
Identify budget discrepancies, financial exposures, and opportunities for cost optimization.
Prepare and present timely, accurate financial reports and project performance updates to company leadership and partners.

Accounting & Team Leadership

Lead, supervise, and mentor accounting personnel, ensuring accountability, accuracy, and timely completion of deliverables.
Oversee financial reporting, reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and accounting across multiple corporate entities.
Maintain strong financial controls and ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
Coordinate with internal departments, financial institutions, auditors, legal advisors, and external consultants.
Establish clear reporting expectations, performance standards, and accountability within the accounting team.

Financial Reporting & Process Improvement

Evaluate existing financial reporting procedures, accounting systems, and project tracking processes.
Identify and implement opportunities to streamline workflows, improve accuracy, and increase departmental efficiency.
Develop consistent reporting frameworks that provide leadership with clear visibility into project budgets, cash flow, profitability, and financial risks.
Strengthen internal controls, reporting timelines, and financial accountability.
Proactively recommend improvements to financial management practices and operational processes.

Qualifications & Experience

8–12+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, preferably within real estate development or construction.
Significant experience in high-rise residential development accounting and finance; exposure to commercial and purpose-built rental developments is an asset.
Demonstrated experience preparing development feasibility studies, financial models, sensitivity analyses, and project cash flow forecasts.
Strong understanding of real estate development economics, construction financing, development costs, and investment return metrics.
Proven experience managing multiple project budgets and overseeing financial reporting across multiple corporate entities.
Demonstrated leadership experience supervising and developing accounting personnel.
Strong financial modelling capabilities and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
Experience implementing improvements to financial reporting, accounting systems, and internal processes.
Excellent analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to independently evaluate financial information, challenge assumptions, and present clear recommendations to senior leadership.
Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA designation is preferred.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on financial leader who takes ownership, exercises sound judgment, and proactively identifies opportunities to improve financial performance and operational efficiency.
The successful candidate will combine technical accounting expertise with a strong understanding of real estate development economics and investment analysis.
They will be comfortable working directly with company leadership and partners, providing thoughtful financial insights, challenging assumptions, and contributing to important business and investment decisions.
Equally important, this individual will demonstrate strong leadership, accountability, attention to detail, and the ability to develop a high-performing accounting team.

Why Join Cortel Group?

This is an opportunity to assume a key leadership position within an established real estate development company, with direct exposure to company leadership and meaningful involvement in development and investment decisions.
The successful candidate will contribute to the financial oversight of a diverse development portfolio while helping shape and improve the systems, processes, and financial reporting practices that support the company's continued growth.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume outlining their relevant experience and qualifications.
We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
